goal: Prevent misleading high-severity errors and log spam during routine network and proxy connection failures
agreement: General support for reducing log noise and adding the helper (sedited, l0rinc)
Nonblocking objection: demoting error levels makes diagnosing failures harder (ryanofsky)

categories.name: p2p
why: P4 because it reduces log noise on connection failures but does not affect protocol logic or DoS resistance
The impact is limited to cleaner logs for node operators

categories.name: utils
why: P3 because it provides a reusable rate-limited logging pattern across multiple modules
It eliminates misleading error-level reporting across the codebase
